mechanism_narrative: A higher current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is inversely related to S&P 500 20-day forward returns, as elevated interest rates increase the cost of capital and reduce the present value of future equity cash flows, leading to negative returns.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market so tight that unemployment falls below 4.5% (UNRATE < 4.5) signals an overheating economy, triggering aggressive monetary tightening and negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5, or the correlation between UNRATE and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5) and the CPI index (CPIAUCSL > 200) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which compresses equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for the joint signal of FEDFUNDS > 4.5 and CPIAUCSL > 200 is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: In a housing market expansion regime (HOUST > 2000), new home construction activity signals strong consumer demand and economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 2000, or the correlation between HOUST and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO < 100) signals weakening manufacturing activity and an impending economic slowdown, which leads to negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to reduced corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100, or the correlation between INDPRO and 20-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A higher current level of real sales and profits (RSAFS) indicates robust corporate performance and economic expansion, which drives positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns through increased investor confidence and capital allocation to equities.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for RSAFS as a predictor of 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 300000.

mechanism_narrative: A payroll employment level above 135,000 (thousands) (PAYEMS > 135000) signals a strong labor market, supporting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 135000, or the correlation between PAYEMS and 20-day returns is not significantly positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns due to the prolonged impact of tight monetary policy on economic growth and equity valuations.
failure_condition: The Rank IC for FEDFUNDS as a predictor of 60-day returns is not significantly negative (p > 0.05) over any 3-year rolling window, or 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%.
